_note: Upgrades sold in the Hardening shop. day is the day the upgrade belongs to: the shop sells the upgrades of the current day and of the earlier days. load is what the upgrade uses of the upgrade load (2 on Day 1, 2N on Day N). price is in Security Points. The icon is assets/upgrades/icon_<id>.png. Every upgrade does two things: its passive (ALWAYS: a general benefit in every fight, see response.gd _apply_passives; keys max_hp, block_per_turn, heal_per_turn, attack_bonus, first_draw, first_energy) and its AGAINST effect (the attack pattern it counters, defined by the pattern's counter in the day's response data). text shows both. clues are the ids of the Investigation clues the upgrade answers: when the player found one, the Upgrade Editor recommends the upgrade.

unique.name: Unique Passwords
unique.against: One password, many accounts: one stolen password opens nothing else.
unique.text:
ALWAYS: +10 max HP.
AGAINST One password, many accounts: one stolen password opens nothing else.

twostep.name: Two-step Sign-in
twostep.against: Stolen password: a stolen password alone is not enough to sign in.
twostep.text:
ALWAYS: +3 Block at the start of each of your turns.
AGAINST Stolen password: a stolen password alone is not enough to sign in.

lockout.name: Lock After Failed Tries
lockout.against: Rapid guesses: too many wrong guesses lock the account.
lockout.text:
ALWAYS: Attack cards deal +2 damage.
AGAINST Rapid guesses: too many wrong guesses lock the account.

alerts.name: Unusual Sign-in Alerts
alerts.against: Every attack: you are warned a little earlier when a sign-in looks strange.
alerts.text:
ALWAYS: Draw 2 extra cards in your first hand.
AGAINST Every attack: you are warned a little earlier when a sign-in looks strange.

allowlist.name: Block Unknown Programs
allowlist.against: Trojan: its disguise comes off at once, so you see what it is.
allowlist.text:
ALWAYS: +3 Block at the start of each of your turns.
AGAINST Trojan: its disguise comes off at once, so you see what it is.

updates.name: Keep Software Updated
updates.against: Worm: a copy can only split once.
updates.text:
ALWAYS: +10 max HP.
AGAINST Worm: a copy can only split once.

antivirus.name: Antivirus Always On
antivirus.against: Spyware: the hidden bullets stay visible.
antivirus.text:
ALWAYS: Heal 4 HP at the start of each of your turns.
AGAINST Spyware: the hidden bullets stay visible.

attachments.name: Scan Attachments
attachments.against: Every attack: a longer warning before it starts.
attachments.text:
ALWAYS: Attack cards deal +2 damage.
AGAINST Every attack: a longer warning before it starts.
